text:
Priya S: quick Q — where do folks look for traces/metrics tying KV-cache evictions to SM% spikes? saw a canary run with weird throughput drops, want dashboard link + a suggested alert tweak to reduce noise

Alex G: Dashboards: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/kv-runtime/gpu-kv-insights -> panels: 'KV Evictions', 'SM Utilization %', 'Batch size distribution'

Alex G: For quick correlation use this metric query in Grafana Explore:
```
metric: runtime.kvcache.evictions.count{env=prod} | rate(5m)
metric: runtime.gpu.sm_utilization{instance=~"gpu.*"} | avg by (instance)
```

Mia L: For traces, open Trace Explorer (https://traces.internal.redwood). Filter: `service:runtime AND span:kvcache* AND tag.eviction:true` — that will show request traces where eviction happened and you can inspect token counts/kv hits in the span attributes.

Mia L: If you want a trace example, run the small repro: `python infra/bench/repro_kv_eviction.py --model gpt-medium --seq 1024 --batch 8` and then filter by `trace.tag.repro=true` in explorer.

Shawn R: FYI I opened a tiny alert PR to reduce paging for noise: https://git.internal.redwood/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/482 — lowers severity for kvcache.evictions rate from alert to warning for <5m spikes and increases sample window to 10m.

ops-bot: Alert change preview:
```yaml
- alert: KVCacheEvictionsHigh
  expr: increase(runtime_kvcache_evictions_total[10m]) > 100
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache evictions high (10m)"
```

Priya S: perfect, thanks. One more — is there a prefetched dashboard for canary runs (we want to compare canary vs prod SM% under same batch sizes)?

Alex G: yes — use the 'Canary vs Prod' dropdown on the same dashboard, pick the canary tag or the instance group `canary-*`. Also check the 'batch size heatmap' panel to see distribution spikes.

Priya S: cool. pinging @Alex G for a quick review of the SHIELD alert tweak before Shawn merges — want to make sure we don't hide real regressions. :eyes:

Alex G: will review today, if green I'll merge and deploy to staging (then ops-bot will post deploy)

deploy-bot: deployed commit 9c4a7f to staging at 2026-03-17T15:24:44Z — ops-alerts/service-config

Priya S: thanks all — I'll link the trace examples to the incident ticket and leave notes on suggested threshold changes.

Mia L: If you need a quick query for traces in CI logs:
```
# jaeger query example
service="runtime" spanName~"kv_eviction" tags.eviction=true | sort -r duration | head 5
```

Shawn R: tagging this thread in the PR and the ticket: RED-4723. will hold off final merge until Alex gives ack.

Alex G: acked, will try to get to it before EOD. :thumbsup:

Priya S: thanks everyone :)
